chunks: From Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: There is no manumission for the believer after death.
Nor is there a deferment of his debt.
Nor is there charity given on his behalf.
ai.seo_question: What happens to a believer's debts and charity after death according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq records this ruling to clarify that the default estate distribution follows the Quranic shares unless a specific *wasiyyah* (bequest) was made, distinguishing it from the pre-Islamic practice of arbitrary disposal. This highlights the Shia emphasis on the precision of testamentary instructions in preserving the rights of heirs and ensuring the deceased's specific wishes are honored within the legal framework.
